info.title: JoinSplit Application API
info.description:
Contract for the Laravel application API used by the local-first JoinSplit
client. Anonymous mutations use a client-held Access Identity credential;
Account operations use a server-side session, CSRF protection and explicit
optimistic revisions. See `docs/api/README.md` before using this description.

servers.description: Public beta showcase; fictional, non-sensitive test data only

get.summary: Check whether the application process is running

503.description: At least one required dependency is unavailable.

post.summary: Register or verify a client-held Access Identity
post.description: Both security schemes are required. The bearer value must be 32 random bytes encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

patch.summary: Archive or reactivate an anonymous Group

post.summary: Add a Participant to an anonymous Group

patch.summary: Rename, activate, deactivate, or associate one Participant
patch.description: Exactly one of `name`, `active`, or `personId` must be sent.

get.summary: Start a session and obtain its CSRF token

200.description: CSRF token for subsequent state-changing Account requests.

post.summary: Register and sign in an Account

delete.summary: Permanently delete the signed-in Account and its server data

204.description: Password changed; other Account sessions invalidated.

202.description: Generic response regardless of Account existence.

503.description: Password recovery is not configured in this environment.

put.summary: Update one or more Account preferences

post.summary: Link an existing anonymous Access Identity to the Account
post.description: Requires the Account session and the anonymous identity's current credential. A linked credential is permanently disabled.

post.summary: Create or verify an Account-owned Access Identity ID

get.summary: Read the complete Account workspace snapshot

post.summary: Import one local Group snapshot into an Account
post.description: The route and snapshot Group IDs must match. Relationships and financial-history markers are validated as one graph.

post.summary: Import local People and their Participant associations
Create a Group in the Account workspace

patch.summary: Archive or reactivate an Account Group

204.description: Group deleted; next revision is in `X-Group-Revision`.

post.summary: Add a Participant to an Account Group

patch.summary: Rename, activate, deactivate, or associate one Participant

204.description: Participant deleted; next revision is in `X-Group-Revision`.

post.summary: Create an equal-split Expense in an Account Group

put.summary: Replace an Expense in an Account Group

delete.summary: Delete an Expense from an Account Group

204.description: Expense deleted; next revision is in `X-Group-Revision`.

post.summary: Record a Settlement in an Account Group

put.summary: Replace a Settlement in an Account Group

delete.summary: Delete a Settlement from an Account Group

204.description: Settlement deleted; next revision is in `X-Group-Revision`.
Person deleted; next revision is in `X-Person-Revision`.

bearerCredential.description: Anonymous Access Identity credential generated and retained by the client.

accessIdentityHeader.name: X-Access-Identity-ID
accessIdentityHeader.description: UUID v4 of the Access Identity.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
CsrfToken.description: Token returned by `GET /api/account/csrf` for the same session.

MutationId.name: X-Mutation-ID
MutationId.description: Fresh UUID v4 for this logical mutation; reuse only for an exact retry.

GroupRevision.name: X-Group-Revision
GroupRevision.description: Current non-negative Group revision; use `0` when creating a Group.

PersonRevision.name: X-Person-Revision
PersonRevision.description: Current non-negative Person revision; use `0` when creating a Person.

AccountAccessIdentityId.name: X-Access-Identity-ID
AccountAccessIdentityId.description: Account-linked Access Identity that will own the new Group.

AdoptionId.name: adoption
AdoptionId.description: UUID v4 identifying one resumable adoption process.

GroupRevision.description: Resulting Group revision after the successful mutation.

PersonRevision.description: Resulting Person revision after the successful mutation.

Unauthenticated.description: Authentication failed or no valid session exists.

NotFound.description: Requested resource was not found in the authorized scope.

Conflict.description: Revision, replay, uniqueness, relationship or lifecycle conflict.

actorId.description: Access Identity performing the creation; it must match the authenticated or Account-linked identity.
